entities.summary: Safiah binti Nik Abdul Karim is a Malay language grammarian in Malaysia. She earned her PhD from Ohio University and is former dean of the Faculty of Arts and Social Science at University of Malaya. Nik Safiah Karim was a writers & intellectuals from Kota Bharu (b. 1939-12-17, Kota Bharu). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
